topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't sit still, my hands trembling as I scroll through old photos. There he is, that face, frozen in time, the same one my kid sees every day. My mind races, a jumble of half-formed thoughts and sharp fears. I need to do something, say something, but the words get lost in the chaos of my thoughts. This can't be happening. I pace the room, glance at the clock, and back to the photos. How will I explain this? What will I tell my child? I have to find a way to fix this, to protect them from the shadows of my past. But how? Where do I even start?
